metadata.description: Publish one skill to every agent-skill store at once — at home and abroad, free and paid — using the submission form each store actually accepts.

plugins.name: publish-to-all-skill-stores
plugins.description: Playbook + tooling for publishing agent skills: repo layout for auto-indexers, public submit APIs, GitHub-PR registries, login-gated CLIs, platform-hosted stores that need porting, and how to price a paid listing.
